name: logmaster
description: LogMaster - Sistema de Control de Acceso de Visitantes

scripts.test: pnpm run test:server && pnpm run test:client
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
scripts.local:prepare: docker compose --profile test build && docker compose --profile test up -d --wait postgres mailpit && docker compose run --rm ops migrate && docker compose run --rm ops seed
scripts.test:integration: sh scripts/containers/smoke.sh && pnpm exec playwright test
